decisions.question: Single live configuration source for Application/Platform
decisions.statement: One RuntimeConfig port created once in bootstrap: a live facade over CONFIG; every getter, fightPhysicsConfig included, reads per call (no cache). Application/Platform receive only the port or narrow slices through constructors; direct CONFIG access stays only in bootstrap/config and DEV.
decisions.consequence: A DEV replacement of CONFIG.fightPhysicsConfig reaches every consumer (DEV-only behaviour; nothing player-visible). Resolves the ConfigProvider adapter cache debt (src/app/adapters.js ConfigProvider constructor).
decisions.rejected: B: pass the raw live CONFIG to every consumer (as prerequisite 020).

decisions.question: Does the port read BASE_CONFIG + CONFIG_OVERRIDE_STORE already in M1?
decisions.statement: The port reads the live CONFIG; BASE_CONFIG / CONFIG_OVERRIDE_STORE (src/config/runtime/*) stay a DEV mechanism until Stage 6, where unifying base + overrides behind the port is a deferred task.

decisions.question: Release version line for Stage 4
decisions.statement: Stage 4 releases start at 0.25.0; one release per milestone (M1, M2, ...).
